packages/testkit/src/evals/judge-identit.description: Lists which recorded judge fields differ between two reports.

packages/testkit/src/evals/compare.ts.description: Validates two reports, refuses mismatched settings and lists trials that went from passed to failed.

packages/testkit/src/evals/step-accounti.description: Partitions usage ledger calls by step and reconciles totals against the workflow.
